The plate is roughly 26 cm across, and the fruits are about 2.3 cm in diameter. I count about 16 of them. They are dark red and glossy, with a small stem visible on one, so they are most likely red grapes. Cherries are the look-alike, but these show no stem dimples and look like grapes. Each weighs about 5-6 g, so the total is about 90 g.
